reuse.why: Instead of extracting the local-detach part of the existing unlinkAccount, the diff copies its field-reset updateAccount block verbatim.

duplication.why: The eight-field reset of account_id, bank, balances, account_sync_source and bank_sync_status now exists twice, so the definition of 'unlinked' can drift between the unlink action and the replace path.

placement.why: A state-changing detach is placed inside assertBankAccountNotLinked, a precondition check whose name says it only asserts, so a guard now mutates other accounts.

scope.why: Only the flag, its threading through the six provider link functions and a release note are added.

maintainability.why: Side effects hidden in an assert function plus a copied unlink block would surprise a maintainer; the uniform flag threading through all providers is the one clean part.

bypasses_abstraction.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in server/accounts/app.ts resets the previous holder with its own db.updateAccount instead of sharing the local-unlink logic of unlinkAccount.

disguised_duplication.where: The unlink field reset is copied literally, not reshaped.
